text.standard: Choose a demo applicant to continue.

text_zh.standard: 选择一个演示申请人以继续。

title: How would you like us to help?

text.standard: Choose your language and how the app looks and sounds. You can change this at any time.
text.simple: Pick your language and what helps you. You can change it later.

text_zh.standard: 选择语言以及应用的外观和语音设置。您可以随时更改。
text_zh.simple: 选择语言和适合您的设置。您以后可以更改。

text_ms.standard: Pilih bahasa serta rupa dan bunyi aplikasi. Anda boleh mengubahnya pada bila-bila masa.
text_ms.simple: Pilih bahasa dan tetapan yang sesuai untuk anda. Anda boleh mengubahnya kemudian.

text.standard: Choose how you would like to open your account.
text.simple: How do you want to open your account?

text_zh.standard: 选择您希望如何开设账户。

text_ms.standard: Pilih cara anda mahu membuka akaun.

title: Check you're eligible

text.standard: Confirm your passport country and that you are 18 or older.
text.simple: Check if you can open an account with this app.

verified_info: Remote account opening with an e-passport is for applicants aged 18 and above with a biometric passport from Hong Kong, Malaysia, Indonesia or Mainland China.
suggested_questions: How do I know if my passport is biometric?
What can I do if my passport isn't on the list?

text_zh.standard: 确认您的护照国家/地区，以及您是否年满18岁。
text_zh.simple: 检查您是否可以通过此应用开设账户。

text_ms.standard: Sahkan negara pasport anda dan bahawa anda berumur 18 tahun atau lebih.
text_ms.simple: Semak sama ada anda boleh membuka akaun melalui aplikasi ini.

title: Get ready

text.standard: Have your biometric passport, national ID and an NFC-capable phone ready before you continue.
text.simple: Get these 3 things ready: your passport, your ID card and your phone.

verified_info: You need a biometric passport, your national ID card, and a phone that can read NFC chips. A biometric passport has a small chip symbol on its cover.
suggested_questions: How do I check if my phone has NFC?

text_zh.standard: 继续之前，请准备好生物识别护照、身份证和支持NFC的手机。
text_zh.simple: 准备好护照、身份证和手机。

text_ms.standard: Sediakan pasport biometrik, kad pengenalan dan telefon yang menyokong NFC sebelum meneruskan.
text_ms.simple: Sediakan pasport, kad pengenalan dan telefon anda.

title: Scan your passport chip

text.standard: Hold your phone against your passport so the app can read its chip using NFC.
text.simple: Put your phone on your passport and keep still.

verified_info: The app reads the chip inside your passport using NFC. Hold your phone flat against the passport and keep both still until the scan finishes. Removing a thick phone case can help.
suggested_questions: Where is the chip on my passport?
How do I know if my phone has NFC?

text_zh.standard: 将手机贴近护照，以便应用通过NFC读取芯片。
text_zh.simple: 将手机放在护照上并保持不动。

text_ms.standard: Letakkan telefon pada pasport supaya aplikasi boleh membaca cip menggunakan NFC.
text_ms.simple: Letakkan telefon pada pasport dan jangan gerakkannya.

title: Verify it's you

text.standard: Take a photo of your national ID and complete a face check.
text.simple: Take a photo of your ID card. Then look at the camera.

verified_info: The app checks that you are the passport holder and checks your national ID. In this prototype, verification is simulated and no real biometric data is collected.
suggested_questions: Why couldn't it read my ID?
What happens with my face photo?

text_zh.standard: 拍摄身份证照片并完成人脸验证。
text_zh.simple: 拍摄身份证照片，然后看向摄像头。

text_ms.standard: Ambil gambar kad pengenalan dan lengkapkan pemeriksaan wajah.
text_ms.simple: Ambil gambar kad pengenalan. Kemudian lihat kamera.

title: Supporting documents

text.standard: Upload your qualifying supporting documents within the required timeframe.
text.simple: Upload the documents we ask for.

verified_info: You need to provide qualifying supporting documents within the required timeframe. The accepted documents are listed on this screen.
suggested_questions: How long do I have to upload them?

text_zh.standard: 请在规定时间内上传符合要求的辅助文件。

text_ms.standard: Muat naik dokumen sokongan yang layak dalam tempoh yang ditetapkan.

title: Review and submit

text.standard: Review your details and declarations, then submit your application.
text.simple: Check everything, then send your application.

verified_info: Check your details before you submit. After OCBC receives your supporting documents, it may take up to 21 working days to tell you whether your account has been opened.
suggested_questions: How long until my account is ready?

text_zh.standard: 检查您的资料和声明，然后提交申请。
text_zh.simple: 检查所有资料，然后提交申请。

text_ms.standard: Semak maklumat dan pengisytiharan anda, kemudian hantar permohonan.

title: What happens next

text.standard: Your application has been submitted. We will notify you once it has been reviewed.
text.simple: Your application is sent. We will tell you when it is ready.

verified_info: OCBC may take up to 21 working days after receiving your supporting documents to confirm your account. You may need to complete an initial deposit or other follow-up steps.
suggested_questions: What do I need to do next?

text_zh.standard: 您的申请已提交。审核完成后，我们会通知您。
text_zh.simple: 申请已提交。我们会在审核后通知您。

text_ms.standard: Permohonan anda telah dihantar. Kami akan memaklumkan anda selepas semakan.
text_ms.simple: Permohonan dihantar. Kami akan memaklumkan anda selepas semakan.
